title: Seuerus with Eusebius
summary: Raleigh names Seuerus with Eusebius in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Seuerus, named with Eusebius and Theodoret, who supposed that the gap and Balthasar were brethren and sonnes of Nabuchodonosor. A name between Eusebius and Seuerus is a gap and was not filled. He is not Seuerus the Roman Emperour. The one-word title would fold onto severus-emperor, so the title is three words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
